name: Florida Hotel
detail: The cost-performance ratio is high, breakfast is quite good, the rooftop pool is relatively small with basically no space for loungers, but the view is very beautiful. The location is also good, with a pharmacy and some small restaurants nearby, and it's quite close to the bank. You must try the sugarcane juice across the street, it's only 12K and very tasty! The front desk staff are also very nice, but the check-in time is a bit late; is it really that tight for rooms in such a large hotel?

name: Panorama Nha Trang StarBeach
detail: The hotel has a youthful, modern design that looks newly finished. The rooms are clean, spacious, and fully equipped with amenities. The staff is enthusiastic and cheerful, creating a close and pleasant atmosphere for guests.

name: Holi Panorama Condotel
detail: Overall Review: The location is very good, the staff are friendly, and the value for money is great. Advantages: 1. The location is excellent as it is right in front of the beach. 2. The lobby and rooms are clean. 3. The swimming pool on the 6th floor is decent. 4. There is a hotel KakaoTalk QR code in the room for contact, and they respond very kindly. 5. It is nice to use the Blue Sky on the 40th floor. Disadvantages: 1. There is a spa on the 6th floor, but you need to pay a separate fee (40,000-50,000 VND per hour) to use it. 2. There are not many elevators, so there can be some waiting time.

name: Sea Light Hotel Nha Trang Beach
detail: The cost-performance ratio is extremely high. First, there is cleaning every day, it's clean, and they provide bottled water. Second, the location is very convenient, very close to the Agarwood Tower and the beach, but it's in an alley so it's not noisy. There's a juice shop in the alley run by an elderly lady that serves very good juice for only 25k. There's an elevator, and it has all the necessary facilities, cheap yet everything you need is included. The front desk charges 350k for a taxi to the airport, but I went alone to the bus terminal to take a bus to the airport. Highly recommended.

name: Tuana Hotels Cam Ranh Resort
detail: I used the connecting room and found some sand and dust on the floor. If you're going to have breakfast, make sure to purchase the package that includes it. If you want to eat separately, it costs 350,000 VND per person (for ages 6 and older). The breakfast cost is more expensive than the accommodation cost. There was a staff member who spoke Korean. The beach is right in front, and the swimming pool was beautiful despite being in direct sunlight. It's good value for money. They do not provide airport pickup or drop-off services.

name: Bondi Backpackers Nha Trang
detail: This cute hostel is located in a wide alley that cars can access right in the center. Although it's a bit far from the beach, you can walk there, and it's close to coffee shops and restaurants. The hostel has an elevator, and the clean dorm room prices include a simple breakfast along with coffee and tea on the rooftop. Additionally, the owner is very friendly, cheerful, welcoming, and attractive. Note: The hostel turns off the air conditioning from 9 AM to 2 PM, making it very hot, so everyone should go out during this time. The rest of the day, the air conditioning is very cool. I booked at a higher price, so I got assigned a large bed that was super comfy. Everyone should choose a bed on the second floor for more airflow. I would suggest the hostel install a small fan by each bed and regularly clean the bathrooms and showers to avoid clogged drains and overflowing toilet trash bins.

name: RIS Panorama Nha Trang
detail: I was worried after seeing insect-related reviews after making a reservation, but I didn't see any bugs during my 5-night stay. The cleaning was done thoroughly every day, and the room was very comfortable. I definitely had to turn down or turn off the air conditioning because it got really cold in the early morning. The location was good, the room was great, and although the elevator took some time, it wasn't inconvenient. I plan to use it again next time.

name: Rembrandt Hotel Nha Trang
detail: * It seems to be the best value hotel in Nha Trang... - The building is old, but it is kept clean and tidy, and considering the price, the room size and condition are also decent. (The oldness is unavoidable, though) - The swimming pool view is great, and there is a nice small bar next to it, creating a good atmosphere. - Breakfast is 80,000 VND and has an excellent value for money composition. (Additionally: it feels better than the breakfast at a 5-star hotel now;;) - Laundry costs 60,000 VND per kg, but it has less creasing and is tidier compared to the 40,000 VND laundry from similar other hotels. - The kind and cute women at the front desk provided a lot of help through a translator. They are the best. - The biggest advantage is the accessibility to the beach, and it wasn't as noisy as I expected. - If you enter the inside alley rather than the beach, there are many delicious and inexpensive restaurants. - On the last day, a bug was found... point deduction.

name: Venue Hotel
detail: Day 1: January 1, 2026 Hotel Name: Venue Hotel, Nha Trang Reservation Source: Agoda Reservation Date: December 18, 2025 Reservation Price: \*** Stay Date: January 1, 2026 Satisfaction with Price: 5 points (out of 5) Location: 5 points Hygiene Condition: 4 points Staff Attitude: 5 points Facility/Convenience: 4 points Review: I made a reservation through Agoda, and upon arrival, the location was very close to the beach. The staff's response was excellent, and they handled the issues I requested very well. The bed linens were not perfectly clean, and there were TVs, air conditioning, and a fan remote, but they were malfunctioning, and I requested repairs, which were addressed immediately. The room was equipped with water, towels, tea and coffee, a hairdryer, soap, shampoo, body wash, a comb, toothbrush, toothpaste, a refrigerator, and a safe. The restaurant was located on the 17th floor with a great view of the beach, and the food was delicious. However, the variety of fruits was not extensive. There was a treadmill on the 19th floor, and there was a swimming pool, but I didn't go in because there was a smell of disinfectant and the water quality wasn't good; however, the view was wonderful. I would like to stay again at this price next time. I hope the kind staff always have good things in their lives~~

name: Green Beach Hotel Nha Trang
detail: It was a hotel where I could enjoy a leisurely and serene rest rather than a bustling and crowded feeling in the city. Although there were slight traces of time, the cleanliness was outstanding, making my stay comfortable. The view from the pool was really beautiful, and the breakfast was also satisfying. I particularly remember how all the staff were always bright and kind. If the opportunity arises again, I would like to visit this place once more.
